about: Lead data specialist with a long track record of turning messy operational records into trustworthy reporting that teams actually rely on. I enjoy mentoring analysts and untangling the kind of legacy pipelines that everyone else has given up on.

experiences.description: Lead a small team responsible for the integrity of the company's core reporting platform, setting standards for validation and lineage. I own the relationship with downstream stakeholders and translate fuzzy business questions into reliable, repeatable datasets.

Rebuilt a brittle batch reporting estate into a tested, well-documented pipeline that finance and operations could finally trust. I also introduced a review process for new data sources that cut recurring quality incidents substantially.

Designed and maintained ingestion processes feeding the customer analytics warehouse, working closely with product teams on event tracking. I mentored two junior engineers and led the migration away from a fragile hand-rolled scheduler.

Built reporting datasets for the commercial team and acted as the go-to person for reconciling figures across disparate source systems. I documented previously tribal knowledge so the team could onboard new starters without weeks of hand-holding.

Developed dashboards and curated datasets for a fast-growing operations group, partnering with analysts to define consistent metrics. I helped retire a sprawl of conflicting spreadsheets into a single agreed source of truth.

Produced regular operational reports and investigated data discrepancies for the support and logistics teams. This is where I learned how much careful validation matters before anyone makes a decision from a number.

projects.title: Site Telemetry Consolidation Platform
projects.summary: Led the data workstream for a platform that pulled equipment telemetry from dozens of construction sites into a single analytical store. My focus was defining the canonical schema and the validation rules that kept noisy field readings from corrupting downstream reporting.

projects.title: Learner Progress Data Hub
projects.summary: Built the data layer behind a hub combining course engagement and fulfilment records for an online learning provider. I designed the reconciliation logic that married learner activity with shipment and access data so the team could report on outcomes end to end.
